payload.title: notification bell shows unread count after a new alert
payload.errorMessage:
expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed

Locator: getByTestId('unread-count')
Expected: "1"
Received: "0"

note: An unread count stuck at 0 looks like the notification never registered — a real bug. But the badge is driven by two independent sources: an initial REST fetch on page load and a websocket push for new events; when the push arrives before the initial fetch resolves, the fetch response briefly overwrites the pushed count with a stale 0 before self-correcting. Retried-then-passed and a steady ~12.5% rate confined to page-load-adjacent assertions match a load-order race, not lost notifications.
